{{Top|leg}}
'''''Hydra''''' was a [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier]] that was part of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]]. The ship was part of a major convoy escorting various [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. The fleet was then [[Mission to Almaran|inspected]] by [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] that was tasked to inspect all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ships and to destroy any freighters carrying [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] to guage the strength and to buy time to muster their forces. The A-wings managed to achieve their objectives despite many of the ships, the '''Hydra''' included, launching [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|Interceptors]] to intercept the A-wings.
